articles.title: That 11-Year-Old Ultron Theory Was Right All Along
articles.summary: The VisionQuest trailer confirms a long-held fan theory: Ultron wasn't destroyed in Age of Ultron—he was absorbed into Vision's mind. Now he's back as a snarky mental roommate, and the show might be a father-son buddy comedy with a dark twist.

articles.title: A Vast Fungal Web Beneath Your Feet Could Be Conscious, Scientists Say
articles.summary: Researchers mapped a mind-boggling network of mycorrhizal fungi in Earth's topsoil—enough to stretch to Pluto and back 172,500 times. Some scientists argue this web may possess a form of consciousness, challenging our definition of intelligence.

articles.title: The Best Metal Detectors for Unearthing Treasure (or at Least Spare Change)
articles.summary: Popular Mechanics tested top metal detectors on beaches and in parks, consulting an expert who's found nearly $1 million in loot. The Minelab Vanquish 440 leads the pack, while the Nokta FindX Pro offers a sub-$200 starter kit.
